theater: 兗州東郡、鄆州濮陽一帶

battle.name: 張子路起義
battle.theater: 兗州東郡、鄆州濮陽一帶
battle.brief: 隋大業十三年（617），張子路在東郡、鄆州一帶聚眾起兵，郡兵不能制，是隋末豫東、兗州一線州縣層級起義的一環。卡面亞述長矛出自兩河流域，與此役相隔一千五百餘年，並無實物關聯；可對照的是隋代步卒的長柄矛與槊，兩者在密集刺擊與結陣逼近上同一脈。

kit.name: 亞述長矛
kit.history: 短柄、長刃，配著鐵鏃。亞述人把它和弓、鐵器綁在一起，兩河流域的城一個接一個陷落。

countries: 大業十三年（617）的張子路起義，發生在隋朝仍然名義上控制的北方核心地帶，交戰的一方是隋朝在兗州東郡、鄆州的官軍與地方武裝，另一方是張子路聚起的起義眾。隋朝一方由郡太守與縣令分掌民政與兵事，郡兵是依制從當地丁口與鄉里挑出的常備武裝，縣另置縣兵，兩者合稱郡縣兵，多年缺乏操練，器械與糧秣全靠本地供應；州級以上可調的部隊是尚書省調發的正規軍，大業年間三次征高句麗與南巡江都，把精銳調離關洛與河北，留在地方的幾乎只有郡縣兵與雜役。起義一方沒有固定編制，張子路以首領身分聚眾，旗下多為流亡農民、逃兵、盜賊與被徵發而來的鄉里丁壯，人數隨攻城略地而增減，兵器以削尖的竹木槍、舊矛、刀、弓箭與改製的農具為主。同一時期北方還有竇建德據河北建夏、李密據瓦崗與洛陽、劉黑闥在河北再起、杜伏威在江淮活動，多股勢力並存，隋朝對江北已無有效的調度。關於張子路本人及其部眾的具體編制，現存史籍留下的記載很有限，但可以確定這是一場以鄉里社會為基礎、以劫掠府庫糧食為主要補給來源的州縣級起義。
countriesEn: The Zhang Zilu uprising of 617 CE, the thirteenth year of the Daye era, broke out in the northern heartland that the Sui still nominally controlled. One side was the Sui administration in Dong Commandery and Yun Prefecture together with its commandery and county levies; the other was the armed multitude gathered by Zhang Zilu. The Sui side worked through commandery prefects and county magistrates, who handled civil administration and local military matters at the same time. Commandery levies were drawn from the registered households of the district, and counties kept their own small detachments; together these were all the troops the dynasty could still raise locally. Years of drill had worn them down, their weapons and grain came from the district rather than from the capital, and the regular units of the Ministry of Wars had been pulled away to the three campaigns against Goguryeo and to the emperor's tour of the south, so that the provinces were left with levies and labour gangs. The rebel side had no fixed order of battle: Zhang Zilu led as a self-styled chief, and those under him were mostly landless farmers on the run, deserters, bandits and villagers conscripted by the state, their numbers swelling or shrinking as towns were taken. Their weapons were sharpened bamboo and wooden spears, old spears, knives, bows and farm tools turned to fighting. At the same moment Dou Jiande was raising Xia in Hebei, Li Mi was gathering strength in Henan, Liu Heitao was active in Hebei again, and Du Fuwei operated in the Jianghuai, so that the Sui could no longer coordinate the north. The record for Zhang Zilu himself and for the organisation of his bands is thin, but what can be fixed is this: a county-level rising built on village society, living mainly by seizing grain and stores from the government granaries.
people: 起義的首領是張子路。這位領袖在現存史料中留下的蹤跡極少：正史與《資治通鑑》一類編年史只把他作為大業十三年在東郡、鄆州聚眾抗隋的渠帥提上一筆，既無小傳，也無家世與出身的交代，這與同年竇建德、李密等人留下完整行狀的情形形成對照，因此他的一言一行都很難逐條核實。與他同時在北方活動的另一位關鍵人物是李密：617年，李密在瓦崗與翟讓的聯軍中逐步取得主導權，擊敗隋將張須陀，進而在年底攻入洛陽，把中原的糧食與人丁收進囊中，而張子路所在的兗州正是李密軍北上與東進的必經之地。河北方向的竇建德同年稱夏王，也在爭奪同樣的郡縣與糧道。較早的山東先例是611年王薄在泰山郡首義、寫《無向樓詩》號召天下，王薄其後在與鄰近起義者的火拼中被殺，《資治通鑑》記作張金、張善通誅之，眾遂散，說明山東一帶的起義傳統與部眾流動早有先例。隋廷方面，隋煬帝楊廣自605年即位，先廢太子楊勇，繼而誅其子楊昭，倚重楊素、宇文述、封德彝三大臣，並把巡遊江都當作常例；遠離北方戰線的君主與空虛的郡縣防務，構成了這場起義得以蔓延的制度背景。
peopleEn: The leader of the rising was Zhang Zilu. Almost nothing survives about him: the official histories and the annalistic works such as the Zizhi Tongjian mention him only in a single line as a chief who raised a multitude against the Sui in Dong Commandery and Yun Prefecture in the thirteenth year of Daye, with no biography, no family background and no account of how he rose, in sharp contrast to the full dossiers left by Dou Jiande and Li Mi in the same years, and every word about him is therefore hard to verify. The other key figure active in the north at the same moment was Li Mi: in 617 Li Mi took the leading hand in the Wagang coalition with Zhai Rang, defeated the Sui general Zhang Xutuo and entered Luoyang before the end of the year, drawing in the grain and the people of the central plain, and the Yun Prefecture where Zhang Zilu operated lay directly on Li Mi's road north and east. Dou Jiande, who called himself king of Xia in Hebei that same year, was competing for the same commanderies and supply roads. There was an older precedent in Shandong: in 611 Wang Bo rose in Taishan Commandery and called the realm together with his Wu Xiang Lou poem, only to be killed later in a clash with neighbouring insurgents, the Zizhi Tongjian naming Zhang Jin and Zhang Shantong as his killers, and his bands scattered. On the court side, Emperor Yang of Sui, who had reigned since 605, had deposed Crown Prince Yang Yong and then put Yang Zhao to death, relied on the three ministers Yang Su, Yuwen Shu and Feng Deyi, and made his tours of Jiangdu a routine; a sovereign far from the northern front and a hollow provincial defence made the spread of this rising possible.
kits: 卡面兵器是亞述長矛，約公元前900年出現於兩河流域，短柄、長刃、配著鐵鏃，是亞述人用來配合弓與鐵器攻城野戰的刺擊兵器。距此役一千五百餘年，張子路的起義眾自然不可能持有亞述長矛；把它放上卡面，是要標示一條從亞述城戰一路傳到隋代步兵的技術脈絡，也就是密集刺擊與結陣逼近。隋軍與起義眾真正使用的長柄兵器是矛與槊：槊是長桿刃兵，桿長在兩丈上下，握於中段，衝鋒時靠腰胯的旋轉把刃部送入敵陣；步卒的矛柄約丈許，鏃多為鐵質或銅質，北方鄉兵配發的則是較短的木柄矛，以及兼作工具的農具改製品。防護上，隋軍正規軍有鐵札甲與皮甲，郡縣兵與起義眾多靠皮甲、麻衣與藤牌，弓弩數量有限，箭鏃多為薄鐵片，甚至不帶鏃。攻城一方用得上的器械包括雲梯、衝車、撞竿與擲石，投石機則多留在官軍手中。運輸方面，運河與濟水水系提供了沿運河北運的船隻，鄉里起義者則靠車、騾、扁擔與河道小船運糧。
kitsEn: The card carries the Assyrian spear, a weapon that appears in Mesopotamia around 900 BC: a short shaft, a long blade, an iron head, the implement the Assyrians tied together with bows and ironwork as their cities fell one after another. Fifteen hundred years separate that spear from the rising of Zhang Zilu, and no rebel in the Chinese countryside could ever have carried one; putting it on the card marks the one thread that does run from the Assyrian assault on cities to the spearmen of the Sui, namely the massed thrust of a close-order bayonet. The long-handled weapons actually used by the Sui soldiers and by the rebels were the spear and the shuo: the shuo is a long-shafted blade weapon some two zhang in length, gripped in the middle, which a fighter rotates with the waist and hips to drive the blade forward in a charge; infantry spears had shafts of about one zhang, with iron or bronze heads, while levies in the north were issued shorter wooden spears and tools converted into weapons. For protection, the Sui regulars wore iron lamellar and leather armour, while commandery and county levies and the rebels relied on leather, hemp clothing and rattan shields, with few bows and crossbows and thin iron arrowheads that were often unbarbed. Besiegers could bring scaling ladders, battering rams, poles and hand-thrown stones, while traction trebuchets stayed mostly in government hands. For transport, the canal and the Jishui system gave barges for the northward grain run, while the village insurgents moved grain on carts, mules, shoulder-poles and small river boats.
tactics: 起義者的戰術圍繞先取糧、後圖城展開。張子路這類州縣首領通常先在鄉里糾集流民與散兵，等郡兵外出、縣城守備空虛或糧道斷續之際，選擇拂曉或夜間以人數優勢撲向縣城、渡口與驛舍；破城之後沒收府庫的粟帛與兵器，把被徵發的丁壯編入自己的隊伍，再轉攻鄰郡，形成滾雪球式的擴張。防守上，起義眾多依城壘固守，於城外挖塹、置拒馬、壘石為壘，充分利用城牆與壕溝抵擋官軍的攻勢；當官軍合圍或糧道被斷，便分散為小股，避實擊虛，往鄰境流竄。官軍這邊則倚靠郡兵與州兵結集，依托堅城作戰，派騎兵巡邏斷糧，偶爾以正規軍宿將為統帥進行追剿；多數時候官軍選擇圍而不攻或撫慰，因為一旦郡兵離城，縣境就更容易被起義軍重奪。亞述長矛所代表的密集刺擊陣，在這裡沒有原樣重演：隋代鄉里起義多靠人數、混雜的步卒與臨時器械，與亞述城下的方陣加盾牆並不可同日而語。
tacticsEn: The tactics of the insurgents turned on a single rule: take the grain first, the city afterwards. Leaders of Zhang Zilu's sort usually first gathered runaways and scattered soldiers in the countryside, then waited for the moment when the commandery levies were away from their posts, when a county seat was thinly held, or when a supply road had been cut; they struck at dawn or in the night, using their numbers to overwhelm county towns, ferry crossings and relay stations. After a town fell they took the grain, cloth and weapons out of the public stores, folded the conscripted villagers into their own ranks, and moved on to the next commandery, growing as they went. In defence the insurgents relied on walls, dug trenches outside them, set up barricades of sharpened wood and piled stone, and used the rampart and the ditch to blunt the counter-attack of the government troops; when the troops closed in or their food ran out they broke into small bands, avoided the strong positions and struck at the weak ones, drifting across the border into the next district. On the government side, commandery and prefectural levies were concentrated for action, fought from solid towns, sent cavalry out on patrol to cut supplies, and now and then pursued the rebels with a regular commander; more often the officials chose to sit around a besieged town or to offer terms of pardon, because the moment a levied battalion left its city the county was likely to be taken back. The massed bayonet charge represented by the Assyrian spear was not reproduced here: village insurgents in the Sui fought with numbers, mixed infantry and improvised equipment, nothing like the phalanx and shield wall that carried the Assyrian attacks on cities.
data: 關於這場起義，能夠核實的數字非常有限。先說年與月：起義繫於隋大業十三年，即公元617年，隋煬帝自605年即位至此在位十二年；起義的確切月份在史籍中沒有留下明確記載，本條按夏秋之際記為七月，僅作定位之用。背景數字則較為確定：隋朝在612年、613年、614年三次征高句麗，役夫與轉輸物資的規模以十萬計；大業元年即605年開鑿的大運河，直到隋亡仍在徵發役夫；617年竇建德於河北稱夏王，李密在同年擊敗隋將張須陀並於年底入洛陽，618年李淵建唐、宇文化及在江都弒煬帝、竇建德稱帝。兵員方面，隋代郡兵通常不過數百人，縣兵數十至百餘，合一郡之縣兵亦難過數千；起義眾的人數沒有可信記載，只能從郡兵不能制一語推知其已超出地方常備武裝的承載力。戰損與俘獲數字全部缺失，任何精確的傷亡統計都無從核對。
dataEn: Very few figures for this rising can be verified. First the dates: the revolt is attached to the thirteenth year of Daye, that is 617 CE, and Emperor Yang of Sui had then reigned twelve years since his accession in 605. The exact month is not recorded in the histories, and this entry places it in the seventh month, between summer and autumn, only as a locator. The background figures are firmer: the Sui campaigned against Goguryeo in 612, 613 and 614, moving labour and transport on a scale running to tens of thousands; the great canal begun in 605 was still consuming corvée labour when the dynasty fell; in 617 Dou Jiande proclaimed himself king of Xia in Hebei, and Li Mi defeated the Sui general Zhang Xutuo and entered Luoyang before the year ended, while in 618 Li Yuan founded the Tang, Yuwen Huaji murdered Emperor Yang at Jiangdu, and Dou Jiande proclaimed himself emperor. On troops: a Sui commandery levy was normally a few hundred men and a county detachment some dozens to a hundred or so, so that even the combined levies of a commandery and its counties seldom exceeded a few thousand. The size of Zhang Zilu's following is not credibly recorded; from the remark that the levies could not contain it one can only infer that it had already outgrown what local troops could manage. Loss figures and captures are entirely missing, and no exact casualty count can be checked against anything.
cause: 起義的成因是隋末多重壓力在山東、河南一線同時塌陷的結果。第一層是役與兵：三次征高句麗把丁口抽走，開鑿運河、營造東都與洛陽的宮室又長年在民間徵夫，轉輸的糧秣靠加派與和繳籌措，農時被反覆佔用。第二層是災荒與饑民：關中、江南、河北接連水旱，饑民成群流入州縣，盜賊隨之而起。第三層是吏治：地方官吏催科急迫，郡兵與縣兵多年欠操、欠械，捕盜無力，反而成了盜賊的目標。第四層是政治中樞的空缺：隋煬帝把治所與巡幸重心移向江都，關洛與河北的精銳被調去東征與南巡，數十年間積累的府兵制與糧道實際上只靠地方撐持。第五層是榜樣效應：自611年王薄在泰山郡首義，隋末十餘年間河北的竇建德、河南的李密、江淮的杜伏威接連舉兵，兗州一帶的地方官與鄉里都清楚鄰境已經無人能問，於是聚眾自保、據城自守的門檻大幅下降。張子路起義正是這種條件下的產物。
causeEn: The revolt came out of a collapse in the north, where several kinds of pressure under the late Sui failed at the same time in Shandong and Henan. The first was service and labour: three campaigns against Goguryeo drew the men away, while digging the canal and building the palaces of the eastern and northern capitals conscripted labour year after year, and the grain for transport was raised by surcharges and forced levies, with the farming seasons repeatedly interrupted. The second was calamity and hunger: floods and droughts struck the Guanzhong, Jiangnan and Hebei regions in turn, starving peasants drifted into the prefectures in bands, and banditry rose with them. The third was the administration: local officials drove collections hard, the commandery and county levies went years without drill or weapons and were too weak to hunt bandits, which made them the target of bandits instead. The fourth was the hollowing out of the centre: Emperor Yang moved the seat of government and the focus of his tours to Jiangdu, and the trained units of Guanzhong, Luoyang and Hebei were pulled away for the eastern and southern campaigns, so that the old militia system and the supply lines of past decades rested in practice on the provinces alone. The fifth was the example of the rest: from Wang Bo's rising in Taishan in 611, with Dou Jiande in Hebei, Li Mi in Henan and Du Fuwei in the Jianghuai rising in turn, everyone in the Yun region could see that the neighbouring districts were already beyond anyone's control, and the threshold for forming bands, holding towns and standing on the defensive dropped sharply. Zhang Zilu's rising was the product of that.
impact: 張子路起義本身的直接結果有限：它既沒有攻下足以改朝換代的大城，也沒有形成跨州郡的政權，隋朝因此延續了一年多才正式崩解。但它在更大的歷史進程裡起了兩種作用。其一，它和其他州縣起義一起，把隋朝的地方武力秩序徹底打散：郡兵與縣兵不是被改編而是被擊潰或帶頭倒戈，原來依制由官府招募、由郡縣供給的鄉里武裝，轉而成了各路起義首領的私兵，隋朝此後再也無法從地方抽調像樣的兵源與糧食。其二，它把豫東、兗州一帶的鄉村社會捲入持續十餘年的戰火：農田荒廢，水利失修，青壯流散，隋末北方的饑荒與流民問題因此更形嚴重。從長時段看，這類基層起義是唐初平定河北的伏線：618年之後竇建德據河北、李密據洛陽，最終都要靠收編、鎮壓或消化地方起義武裝才能安定，而唐廷在621年虎牢破夏、622年再平劉黑闥之後，才真正把兗、鄆、曹、濮一帶重新收歸中央。
impactEn: The direct outcome of the Zhang Zilu rising was limited. It took no city large enough to change the dynasty, and it created no power spanning several commanderies, so the Sui lasted a year or more longer before its formal collapse. Within the larger course of events, however, it did two things. First, together with the other county-level risings it broke the Sui's local order of war for good: commandery and county levies were not reformed but defeated or led away, and the village armed forces that the government had recruited and paid for through the commanderies and counties became the private bands of the various rebel chiefs, so that from then on the Sui could no longer draw proper troops or grain from the provinces. Second, it pulled the village society of eastern Henan and the Yun region into a war that would run for more than a decade: fields went out of cultivation, water works fell into neglect, young men were dispersed, and the famine and refugee problems of the late Sui in the north grew worse. In the long run these grassroots risings were the hidden thread behind the Tang's pacification of Hebei: after 618 Dou Jiande held Hebei and Li Mi held Luoyang, and both had to absorb, suppress or swallow the local rebel bands before they could settle a region, while the Tang court only brought Yun, Yun, Cao and Pu back under central control after breaking Xia at Hulao in 621 and putting down Liu Heitao in 622.
result: 收場的情形必須分兩層來說。就起義本身而言，現存史籍沒有留下張子路部眾覆滅的過程記載，沒有明確的戰役日期、雙方兵力對比，也沒有記下這位首領的結局；他很可能是因為隋朝地方官軍重新集結，或部眾在搶食與分贓中內訌而潰散，也可能是在隨後竇建德與李密爭奪兗、曹、豫東的戰事裡被捲沒。唯一可以確定的結果，是這場起義之後隋朝在兗州東郡、鄆州一帶的統治已名存實亡：郡縣官印仍在，政令卻不再能落實，鄉里的武裝與糧食都歸了各路首領，隋朝在此區的徵發與防守能力實際上已經終止。就隋朝整體而言，大業十三年的地區性起義與河北的夏、河南的瓦崗、江淮的杜伏威、江都的宇文化及同時並存，隋朝在618年三月宇文化及弒煬帝後名存實亡，同年五月李淵建唐，次年竇建德稱帝，真正的結局要等到621年虎牢之戰、622年平定劉黑闥之後才落定。
resultEn: The ending has to be taken in two layers. As for the rising itself, the surviving histories leave no account of how Zhang Zilu's bands were destroyed, no firm date for a battle, no comparison of the two sides' numbers, and no record of the leader's own fate; most likely his following dispersed when the Sui's local troops were able to concentrate again, or when his bands fell to quarrels over food and plunder, and quite possibly he was swallowed up in the later fighting between Dou Jiande and Li Mi for Yun, Cao and eastern Henan. The one outcome that can be fixed is that after this rising the Sui's rule over Dong Commandery and Yun Prefecture had become nominal: the official seals were still in place and the orders still issued, but they no longer took effect, and the armed men and the grain of the villages had gone to the various chiefs, so that the dynasty's ability to raise provisions and to defend the region there had effectively ended. As for the Sui as a whole, the regional risings of the thirteenth year of Daye existed side by side with Xia in Hebei, Wagang in Henan, Du Fuwei in the Jianghuai and Yuwen Huaji at Jiangdu; the dynasty was already a name without substance when Yang was murdered in the third month of the fourteenth year of Daye in 618, Li Yuan founded the Tang in the fifth month of the same year, and Dou Jiande proclaimed himself emperor the year after; the real settlement came only with the battle of Hulao in 621 and the defeat of Liu Heitao in 622.
